characters.summary: Sebastian is a diminutive crustacean who relies primarily on stealth, hiding, and his high social status rather than direct combat. When forced to fight, he is easily overpowered due to his tiny size, though he is surprisingly nimble.
limitations: Lacks offensive power against human-sized or larger opponents

sources.supports: Basic character identity and role as King Triton's advisor and court composer.

unknowns: Exact limits of his durability against magical attacks are not shown.

characters.summary: Shaggy is a cowardly human investigator who avoids combat at all costs. His primary combat tactics involve extreme running speed driven by fear and consuming food items.
limitations: Will not willingly engage in physical combat

sources.supports: Character traits, cowardice, and reliance on flight when faced with monsters.

campaignTags.claim: Frequently wears elaborate disguises to sneak around monsters.

unknowns: Whether his power-scaling in certain media adaptations (like Ultra Instinct) applies to standard continuity.

characters.summary: Shan Yu is a brutal and ruthless Hun warlord possessing immense physical strength, expert swordsmanship, and a hawk companion for reconnaissance. He fights with ruthless efficiency and intimidation.
weaknesses: Overconfident in his army's overwhelming force
limitations: Relies entirely on conventional medieval weaponry and physical might

sources.supports: Shan Yu's role as the primary antagonist, leader of the Huns, and combat skills.

feats.claim: Survives an avalanche that wipes out his entire army, emerging with his top lieutenants.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and defeated the imperial scouts in the mountains.
Trapped and eliminated using a rocket firework.

campaignTags.claim: Rides horses into battle as leader of the Huns.

unknowns: Exact magical or supernatural abilities are absent; purely mortal.

characters.summary: Shrek is a powerful ogre who utilizes brute physical strength, intimidating presence, and improvised wrestling moves. He prefers intimidating foes to avoid conflict, but easily overpowers human and fairytale opponents in close quarters.
weaknesses: Emotional vulnerability concerning his social isolation
limitations: Lacks ranged offensive projectiles or magic

sources.supports: Shrek's physical strength, ogre physiology, and combat style.

feats.claim: Easily defeats an entire arena of armored knights in hand-to-hand combat.

notableResults.note: Defeated a group of heavily armed guards bare-handed.

campaignTags.claim: Stands roughly 7 to 8 feet tall with massive ogre build.

unknowns: Full extent of ogre magical resistance.

characters.summary: Human Shrek is a transformed version of Shrek who possesses normal human proportions and physical fragility, losing his ogre strength and thick hide.
limitations: Temporary form dependent on potion magic
characters.formDifferences: Changes Shrek from an ogre to an ordinary human, losing massive superhuman strength and thick hide in exchange for standard human form.

sources.supports: Human Shrek transformation details and temporary abilities.

unknowns: Exact duration of the transformation without the potion's stability.

characters.summary: Simba as a cub relies on youthful agility, play-fighting, and sharp claws. He lacks the size and weight of an adult lion but compensates with speed and determination.
weaknesses: Physically weak compared to adult predators
limitations: Limited physical strength as a cub

sources.supports: Simba's character background as a lion cub.

unknowns: Combat effectiveness against hostile adult animals without help.

characters.summary: Adult King Simba is a fully grown male lion possessing tremendous apex predator strength, sharp teeth and claws, and powerful wrestling capability suitable for defending his pride.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to fire and overwhelming numbers of hyenas
characters.formDifferences: Changes Simba from a vulnerable cub into a massive, fully grown adult male lion with powerful bite force and heavy physical presence.

sources.supports: Adult Simba's strength, size, and role as king of Pride Rock.

notableResults.note: Defeated Scar in single combat during the burning of Pride Rock.

unknowns: Resistance to specialized poisons or environmental hazards.

characters.summary: Snoopy is an imaginative beagle who frequently adopts elaborate fantasy personas, most notably the World War I Flying Ace. In his fantasies, he pilots a Sopwith Camel, while in reality, he relies on typical canine agility and slapstick cartoon physics.
weaknesses: Gets distracted by root beer, sleeping, or supper
Physical size of an ordinary dog in reality
mobility: Flight (within WWI Flying Ace fantasy context)
limitations: Fantasy combat capabilities depend entirely on his imagination

sources.supports: Snoopy's character traits, fantasy personas like the Flying Ace.

conditional.dependsOn: Imagination and his doghouse acting as an aircraft

campaignTags.claim: Pilots his doghouse as a Sopwith Camel in WWI Flying Ace fantasies.

unknowns: Whether his fantasy exploits have real-world physical impact outside of gags.

characters.continuity: Disney's Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937)
characters.summary: Snow White is a gentle princess with no combat training or offensive capabilities. She relies entirely on kindness, animal companionship, and escaping from threats.
weaknesses: Completely lacking in combat skills or physical strength
limitations: Unable to defend herself physically against hostile attackers

sources.supports: Snow White's passive nature and lack of combat abilities.

unknowns: Extent of forest animal assistance in a direct combat scenario.

characters.summary: Sokka is a non-bender strategist and warrior from the Southern Water Tribe. He relies on martial arts, boomerang mastery, a meteor-sword, and tactical planning rather than elemental magic.
weaknesses: Prone to comedic distraction and overconfidence
limitations: Completely dependent on physical gear and weapons

sources.supports: Sokka's weapon proficiency, boomerang, sword, and tactical role.

feats.claim: Successfully cuts an airship's control surface during the Day of Black Sun using his space-sword.

notableResults.note: Defeats multiple guards using martial arts and his boomerang.

campaignTags.claim: Carries a specialized returning boomerang and a space-sword.
Designs military inventions and hot air balloons during the war.

unknowns: Whether his swordsmanship matches master benders without tactical preparation.
